fundamental.summary: AON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (two small Democratic purchases offset by larger Republican sale 140 days ago) with neutral market sentiment and no recent news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 14 days compounds volatility risk for financials sector.
